title: Chinese Forbidden City Architecture (Jimeng)
description: Traditional Chinese palace architecture using Jimeng. Strong fit for Chinese travel content, history blogs, and Asian cultural marketing.

prompt.main: 北京故宫太和殿特写，红色宫墙金色琉璃瓦，飞檐翘角细节可见，晴朗蓝天白云，游客小人在前景展现建筑宏伟，工笔建筑画风格，传统中国建筑美学
prompt.negative: 现代建筑，西方建筑，卡通，3D，模糊

explained.why: 写实 (realistic) preset for architectural photography.

tutorial.intro: Chinese architecture = named building + color palette (red + gold) + "工笔建筑画" (architectural painting) style. Jimeng handles it natively.
steps: Building: 北京故宫太和殿特写 — name the building + specific angle.
Material: 红色宫墙金色琉璃瓦 — red walls + gold tiles = Forbidden City signature.
Detail: 飞檐翘角细节可见 — flying eaves = traditional Chinese roof.
Sky: 晴朗蓝天白云 — clear sky for color contrast.
Scale: 游客小人在前景展现建筑宏伟 — tiny person for scale.
Style: 工笔建筑画风格 — gongbi architectural painting style.
tutorial.tips: Forbidden City = red walls + gold tiles + flying eaves. These three together = "Imperial China".

crossModel.midjourney: MJ v6.1: "forbidden city, red walls, gold tiles, flying eaves --ar 16:9 --v 6.1 --s 700".
crossModel.stable_diffusion: SDXL + RealisticVision. Jimeng is best for Chinese architecture.
crossModel.dall_e: DALL-E 3: "A close-up of the Forbidden City Hall of Supreme Harmony, red walls, gold tiles, flying eaves, clear blue sky".
crossModel.jimeng_zh: 北京故宫太和殿特写，红色宫墙金色琉璃瓦，飞檐翘角细节可见，晴朗蓝天白云，游客小人在前景展现建筑宏伟，工笔建筑画风格，传统中国建筑美学。

faq.q: Why does my Chinese building look like a generic temple?
faq.a: You forgot "red walls" + "gold tiles" + "flying eaves". These three = Forbidden City specifically.
Add "tourist small figure in foreground". Tiny person + giant building = immediate scale.
16:9 with clear sky + named building + tiny figure. Reads as "travel China" instantly.
